feasibility.note: Projected fitness by race day ≈ CTL 97 (from 56 now, via the engine's projection through the planned blocks (ACWR-capped)) — at/above the ~CTL 45 a healthy marathon finish needs. That supports **finishing Golden Marathon (A2) healthy**; the engine re-reads this each block as measured fitness moves. note: Easy pace ~5:02/km — if your easy runs are habitually faster than this they're really threshold effort; the re-base deliberately runs slower to build the aerobic base. (See the Effort-discipline panel for how your actual easy runs measure up.)
